SELECT bonus.bonus_plan_id tradeId, bonus.finprod_id portfolioId, FP.FINPROD_ABBR portfolioName
FROM PRD_BONUS_PLAN_N bonus LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp on bonus.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE bonus.bonu_scalc_flag = '01' and del_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} and not exists ( select 1 from trd_product_deal deal where bonus.BONUS_PLAN_ID=deal.B_TRADE_ID AND deal.BUSI_TYPE='17' AND deal.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F16','F24') AND deal.PS='C8' AND deal.TRADE_STATUS='01' AND DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' )
